lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Monaco and validated against AI-mapped estimates, achieving approximately 97% coverage of total buildings. Data represents volunteered geographic information with an average age of 3 months, providing a spatial inventory of building stock for exposure assessment.
